question: What is the antonym of "Derelict"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Attentive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Derelict"** refers to something that is abandoned, neglected, or in a very poor condition. (परित्यक्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The old factory has been derelict for years, with broken windows and crumbling walls.
 
 
• The word **"Attentive"** is the antonym of "Derelict". It means being alert, watchful, or showing care and attention. (सतर्क / ध्यान देने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher praised the student for being attentive during the lecture.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Attentive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dilapidated** (जर्जर): Something that is in a state of ruin or disrepair, often due to neglect or age.
 
 
• **Example:** The dilapidated house was barely standing after years of neglect.
 
 
 
• **Deserted** (सुनसान / परित्यक्त): A place that is empty of people or something that has been abandoned.
 
 
• **Example:** The streets were deserted after the storm warning was issued.
 
 
 
• **Ruined** (बर्बाद): Something that has been destroyed or severely damaged.
 
 
• **Example:** The ruined castle was a popular tourist attraction despite its condition.
